{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Blue Devil Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] built by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After discovering Tarrak's [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] where she was building [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] launched an [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|assault]] to put an end to her attempt to proliferate the TIE Defenders. After her original fighter defenses were destroyed '''Blue Devil Squadron''' was dispatched, likely before their shields were fully charged, to attack the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Grey Wolf]], while [[Red Devil Squadron]] attempted to provide fighter escort. They were intercepted and destroyed by a [[Missile Boat]] piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
The fighter squadron appears in Battle 10, mission 6. The fighter squadron is labeled in the game '''Blue Devl'''. As the other TIE Defender Squadron is called '''Red Devil''' and there is a Y-wing Squadron called [[Gold Devil Squadron]]. This article assumes its a typo on the game designers behalf.
